run_select_sentences_tfidf: run the script to select TF-IDF relevant sentences from ELI5 documents for a given slice
run_select_pars: run select_pars to extract top TF-IDF scored sentences from documents given a QA dictionary
run_make_example: run make_example to build a QA example with question, selected document, and answer fields
run_setup_args: run setup_args to parse CLI arguments for slice ID, number of selected passages, and context size
review_select_pars: review select_pars to understand how TF-IDF scoring and context window selection work for sentence extraction
